intent: Cluster test verifying testplugin commands can hook prePeek/postProcess in addition to peek/process, that stage data reaches the client response, and that process()-time DB writes are visible in postProcess but not in peek/prePeek.

objects.name: checkWithoutThis
objects.role: a no-op tautological assertion (ASSERT_EQUAL(1,1)) called once from prePeek()

objects.name: PrePeekPostProcessTest::prePeek
objects.role: prepeekcommand: checks prePeek/peek info round-trip and the row isn't inserted yet

objects.name: PrePeekPostProcessTest::postProcess
objects.role: postprocesscommand: checks a process()-inserted row is absent at peek, present at postProcess

objects.name: PrePeekPostProcessTest::prePeekPostProcess
objects.role: prepeekpostprocesscommand: checks a process()-deleted row is present at peek, gone at postProcess

misfits.why: a free function asserting a hardcoded tautology, not exercising any Bedrock behavior; reads as a leftover probe rather than part of the test's stated intent

naming_quality.note: checkWithoutThis's name doesn't convey what it does or why it exists
